summary: Frontend-only SEO iteration testing on BestBuyIncentives static SPA. Verified 5 new category pages (routes render, h1, byline, FAQ, hero+bottom CTA to /contact), desktop Programs dropdown (6 links), Guides & Tools block on Home and /resources (17 links each) with sample navigation, footer Programs column (6 links + disambiguation), /programs H1, /about subtitle, article/resource card bylines linking to /authors/karl-kramer, and mobile hamburger Programs section (6 links). All 10 requested feature groups pass. 50/50 effective checks passed; 5 initial false-fails were only due to CSS uppercase transform on byline text and were re-verified manually.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryPage.jsx contains a visible METHODOLOGY placeholder line in RESULTS_HTML ('[METHODOLOGY LINE: Jed and Karl to supply the exact wording. Placeholder: ...]') which is rendered to end users on all 5 category pages. This is copy-content debt, not a functional bug, but should be replaced before publishing to production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 category routes (/vacation-certificates, /travel-certificates, /vacation-incentives, /travel-incentive-programs, /sales-incentive-programs) render CategoryPage correctly with data-testid=category-h1, category-byline, category-faq, category-cta-hero, category-cta-bottom. Byline inner text renders uppercased via CSS (font uppercase class) — when asserting 'By Karl Kramer' use case-insensitive comparison. Desktop Programs dropdown revealed via hover on nav-programs-trigger; 6 nav-programs-* items work. Guides & Tools has exactly 17 guides-link-* items on both / and /resources. Footer Programs column and disambiguation ('Not affiliated with Best Buy Co., Inc.') present. /programs H1='Vacation Certificate Programs'. /about contains 'Karl Kramer & Company, Inc.'. /articles has 71 article-card-byline-* links; /resources has 6 resource-byline-* links, all pointing to /authors/karl-kramer. Mobile viewport (390px) hamburger shows nav-mobile-programs with 6 nav-mobile-programs-* links.
